terms.comment: In Plautus, where rēctum ōstium is the front door.

phrases.latin: pater et Theodōrus cum aviā per postīcum in hortum exiērunt
phrases.english: Dad and Theo went out into the garden by the back door with Grandma

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 122.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
